description: Header file defining the V4L2MjpegDecodeAccelerator class for hardware-accelerated MJPEG decoding using V4L2 in Chromium's media GPU component. It declares classes, methods, and data structures related to MJPEG decoding acceleration.

classes.name: V4L2MjpegDecodeAccelerator
classes.description: Class for hardware-accelerated MJPEG decoding using V4L2, managing buffers, decoding tasks, and device interactions.

classes.name: JobRecord
classes.description: Nested class representing a decoding job, processed in FIFO order.

classes.name: BufferRecord
classes.description: Structure representing input/output buffer details, including memory addresses and size.

methods.name: V4L2MjpegDecodeAccelerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with device and task runner references.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the decoder with a client and callback.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Starts decoding a bitstream buffer or a specific task with associated video frame.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current device supports MJPEG decoding.

methods.name: ConvertOutputImage
methods.description: Converts output buffer to a VideoFrame in supported formats.

methods.name: InputBufferQueuedCount
methods.description: Returns the count of input buffers enqueued.

methods.name: OutputBufferQueuedCount
methods.description: Returns the count of output buffers enqueued.

methods.name: ShouldRecreateInputBuffers
methods.description: Determines if input buffers need recreation due to size issues.

methods.name: RecreateInputBuffers
methods.description: Recreates input buffers, returning success status.

methods.name: RecreateOutputBuffers
methods.description: Recreates output buffers, returning success status.

methods.name: VideoFrameReady
methods.description: Callback when a video frame is ready.

methods.name: NotifyError
methods.description: Notifies about an error with a specific task ID.

methods.name: PostNotifyError
methods.description: Posts an error notification asynchronously.

methods.name: DecodeTask
methods.description: Performs decoding of a job record on the decoder thread.

methods.name: ServiceDeviceTask
methods.description: Handles device polling and event processing.

methods.name: DequeueSourceChangeEvent
methods.description: Dequeues source change events from the device.

methods.name: StartDevicePoll
methods.description: Starts device polling thread.

methods.name: StopDevicePoll
methods.description: Stops device polling thread.

methods.name: DevicePollTask
methods.description: Waits for device events in polling thread.

methods.name: DestroyTask
methods.description: Destroys input/output buffers on the decoder thread.
